author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
It turns out everything is still the same after you reach the other shore of the AI migration.
Code is the new binary
Skill/agent/harness/guardrail is the new code
Nothing is really changed.   Software is not what you build, the dark factory is what you are building now.  Yes, you have to review the skills.  You can't vibe-skilling.
If you think you are stilling building software, you are already obsoleted.
